reason: Several API routes read one fixed page of entities (the 100 or 1,000 oldest rows) and filtered it in Python, so anything past that page was invisible: /chat/session-activity never flagged the newest conversations of a project with more than 100, harness-turn interactions, tool-call artifacts and live paired devices vanished once a project or Core held more than 1,000 rows of the kind, DELETE /vpn-profiles no longer saw the active session or policy using a profile, and a retried POST /action-intents no longer found its prior idempotency key and queued a second device action. The intents/handoffs lists were oldest-first with no offset, the terminal output pager could return an empty page whose X-Nebula-Output-Next equalled offset, PUT/PATCH /engagements skipped the workspace_path resolution that POST enforces, and /search reported any internal ValueError as an invalid cursor and accepted negative cursor offsets. storage.py gains find_entities (SQL JSON-payload filters, engagement scope, offset/limit, newest-first ordering) and list_entities gains newest_first; every scan above now filters in SQL, session activity pages through all conversations with one query for the project's pending turns (ChatService.pending_turns), intents/handoffs are paged newest first with offset, both output pagers share _output_page_end with the forward fallback, create/replace/patch share _resolve_engagement_workspace_path, and search decodes its cursor in _decode_search_cursor raising SearchCursorError. The new tests in test_storage.py (find_entities semantics, newest-first paging), test_api.py (101-conversation activity, 1,000-row interaction/artifact/device/VPN fixtures, newest-first intents and handoffs, multibyte output page, workspace_path on PUT/PATCH), test_action_broker.py (device routing and idempotency past 1,000 rows) and test_federated_search.py (negative/garbage cursors, stale projection kind) each fail on main; the other listed files cover the shared pagers, VPN delete, handoff listing, chat pending turns and engagement CRUD paths.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change (response shapes of every touched route are unchanged and the UI callers in ui/src/api/client.ts pass no new parameters). No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through tests/v3/test_api.py) does not exercise thousand-row projects, output paging by byte offset or engagement PUT/PATCH; the Python tests drive them directly. No full suites.
